name: Conservative Voxelization
definition: A hardware-accelerated voxelization algorithm for polygonal models that guarantees conservative correctness: every voxel intersecting the input model is correctly recognized, solving the problem where previous approaches miss intersecting voxels.
summary: Conservative voxelization is a hardware-accelerated algorithm that guarantees every intersecting voxel is recognized by computing exact depth ranges, unlike standard rasterization which misses voxels.
